correctness.rationale: For independent cells f_i(t)=X_i+sqrt(v)(Z_i cos(2πt)+W_i sin(2πt)), covariance 1+v cos2π(t-s) is positive semidefinite; I_i=X_i and y_i=X_i-sqrt(v)Z_i. Exact Gaussian leaf posterior is mean y_i/(1+v), variance v/(1+v). At height j with m equal-size independent children, pseudo-observation merge with exact prior child-integral C=m I_2 multiplies child means by (1+jv)/(1+(j+1)v) and yields variance 2m v/(1+(j+1)v). Induction gives root mean Y/[1+(h+1)v] and reported variance n v/[1+(h+1)v]. Conditioning independent leaves once instead yields Y/(1+v), nv/(1+v). From S-Y/D=((D-1)ΣX_i+sqrt(v)ΣZ_i)/D, D=1+(h+1)v, true variance n[(D-1)^2+v]/D², so the reported-error variance ratio is [1+(h+1)^2v]/[1+(h+1)v]→∞ and Gaussian z-interval coverage tends 0, asymptotic sqrt(2/π)z/sqrt(h+1). Independent rational recombination checks h<=5 and three v; these are checks, analytic induction proves all depths.
